ankleSetup: Ikara magũrũ makinyũrũrũkĩte. Hinyia ciara cia magũrũ mbere, thuutha ũcikũrũrĩre thuutha.
armLibraryCopy: Mũongozo wa kwiinamia guoko na gũkinya ũraihu wa kĩande na ũgitigĩra.
armSetup: Mwĩrĩ wa igũrũ wonekage. Mwana ainamie guoko gũkinya balloon zone.
balanceGameSub: Ikara ũrĩ mũrũgamĩrĩru nĩguo ũcookanĩrĩrie mĩthingo ya balance.
balanceLibraryCopy: Mũongozo wa kwĩrira wa gũthondeka balance na ũteithio.
balanceSetup: Mwĩrĩ wothe woneke. Mwana aikare arĩ mũrũgamĩrĩru, mũmenyereri arĩ hakuhĩ.
bridgeSetup: Koma na mũgongo, maru makũnetio. Ambata nanga kahora ũthondeke daraja.
catchSetup: Taga mũpira mũnoru kahora ũrĩ ũrĩa wa gĩthũri. Mwana aũgwate na moko meerĩ.
clapSetup: Rora camera. Hũũra moko mbere ya gĩthũri o rĩrĩa target ĩkĩng'ara.
crawlSetup: Theria handũ ha gũĩkĩra. Mũkĩrie athambae erekeire kĩnyamũ gĩake kĩendwa.
dailyPlanCopy: Thĩrĩria session ĩmwe ya moko ma igũrũ, ĩmwe ya magũrũ, na ĩmwe ya balance na ũteithio wa mũrĩmi.
drawSetup: Tũmĩra crayon karatathi-inĩ, kana rũmĩrĩra mĩhianano rĩera-inĩ na kĩara.
dressSetup: Tũmĩra practice board ĩrĩ na mabũtũni manene na zips.
feedSetup: Ikĩra bead kanini igũrũ rĩa gĩko. Mwana agatware atagĩkũria.
gaitLibraryCopy: Mũongozo wa kwĩrira wa gũthiĩ na ũteithio na kũthomithia makinyĩ.
gaitSetup: Theria njĩra ĩrĩ salama. Ambata mbere kahora ũgĩteithĩrĩrio.
gripSetup: Tũmĩra sponge ĩrĩ njoru kana stress ball. Mina, kĩrĩrĩria sekondi 3, ũrekie.
headSetup: Teithĩrĩria mwana kwĩkara. Thamithia kĩndũ kĩrĩa kĩrĩraga kahora nĩguo akĩrũmĩrĩre na maitho.
headSub: Rũmĩrĩra nderi ĩrĩa ĩthiĩaga na maitho maku.
langFallbackNote: UI ĩrĩ na Gĩthũngũ translations cia {lang} ikĩthondekwa.
legLibraryCopy: Mũrango wa PT: imaga na guoko kwa gĩcango, kamata rail, nĩgũcokia kĩrĩma na guoko gĩothe. Mũrĩmi agũteithia kuuma thutha angĩrĩa.
legSetup: Rũgama na kũgũrũ kũrĩa kũrĩ na hinya mũnini, ũnyiitĩte mũkono wa kwĩnyiitĩra. Gũtha nderi na kũgũrũ karĩa kangĩ.
marchSetup: Nyita gĩtĩ nĩguo gĩgũteithie. Ambata rĩu rĩmwe rĩmwe nginya ũrĩa wa nanga, ũkũrũmĩrĩra mũgambo wa ngoma.
marchSub: Thiĩ ta thigari ũkũrũmĩrĩra mũgambo wa ngoma.
midlinePrompt: Tambũrũkia guoko ng'ambo ya mwĩrĩ waku
midlineSetup: Ikĩra target mwena ũngĩ wa mwĩrĩ. Mwana atambũrũkie guoko aringe gatagatĩ ka mwĩrĩ.
pinchSetup: Ikĩra beads/pom-poms thĩ ya tray. Mwana amine na kĩara gĩnene na kĩara kĩngĩ.
reachSetup: Ikia gĩthambia kĩnyororo ũraihu wa kĩande. Mwana agĩkinye.
safetyNote: Rĩka angĩkorwo nĩ kũrũma, kĩzunguzungu, kana kũnoga kwa mwanya.
sensorySetup: Tegania mĩĩmo 3 (njoru, ĩrĩ karĩ, na ĩrĩ na tũhũũrĩ). Mwana akũmie o ũmwe.
sensorySub: Kũmia kĩrĩ njoru, kĩrĩ ngumu, na kĩrĩ na tũhũũrĩ.
shoulderSetup: Ikara kana ũrũgame ũgĩthiĩ na igũrũ. Thiringithia mathagu mbere, igũrũ, thuutha, na thĩ.
simonSetup: Mũrĩmi auga mĩthiĩre. Mwana aige rĩrĩa tu Simon oigĩte.
sitstandSetup: Ikara gĩtĩ kĩrĩ na hinya, magũrũ marĩ thĩ. Rũgama kahora, thuutha ũcooke wĩkare.
squatSetup: Rũgamithia magũrũ ta ũraihu wa mathagu, ũnyiite mũkono wa kwĩnyiitĩra, kũna maru kanini, thuutha ũrũgame.
stretchSetup: Nyũrũrũria nyama cia mwĩrĩ iria ikĩrĩte kahora ũgĩteithĩrĩria. Nyita o kũnyũrũrũka kwa sekondi 15–20.
trackSetup: Kĩrĩrĩria mũtwe. Rũmĩrĩra kĩndũ gĩgĩthiĩ kahora na maitho moiki.
trunkSetup: Ikara ũgĩthiĩ na igũrũ. Garũra mwĩrĩ wa igũrũ mwena wa ũmotho na wa ũrĩo kahora.
trunkSub: Garũra mwĩrĩ ũnyite nyoni ĩrĩa ĩgũrũkaga.
videoPlaceholder: Video yaku ya kwĩrira nĩĩkonania haha.
